# check-broken-ref

Read `docs/missing.md` before every change.

## Section 1

When you work on item 1, read the existing code first, write a small failing test, then make the smallest change that passes it. Keep functions short, prefer explicit names over comments, and run the formatter before you stop.

## Section 2

When you work on item 2, read the existing code first, write a small failing test, then make the smallest change that passes it. Keep functions short, prefer explicit names over comments, and run the formatter before you stop.
